title: One answer away
technique: Eight approved still frames set every beat; Seedance only fills the motion between them.
story: At night a shopper on her sofa almost buys the Fig & Cedar candle.
She wonders if it's safe for her cat; the page never says. She gives up.
Across town the owner reads the flat sales as nobody wanting it.
She is about to discontinue it when Scout's orb pops up: Don't guess. Ask them.
Back on the shopper's page: She had one question. Nobody asked.
End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
